proposed_transition.residual: Mixed diagonal-escape established: the collision fibre is not row-invariant (r*b != u, else hinge h=b Good=Bad). Attach to the finite-backward-root machinery: the fibre's tau image {b} U {r_i,u} contains the state (b,h) whose tau-successor (u, u\h) is the canonical mixed nonperiodic state; verify its backward component terminates in a coloured boundary or ZERO root.

theorem: In the all-A collision fibre F={r:r*u=b}, no arm equals the Good input u (r_i=u UNSAT): the A-transition forces the Good hinge h to equal the Bad target b. Hence L_r(U_r)=U_r is impossible, so the fibre is not row-invariant (canonical escape: r*b forced outside U_r={u,b}).
